profiles.shaped_int: greedy budget shaping on integers 2..64 (Thm 3 relaxed)
profiles.shaped_harm: greedy budget shaping on one harmonic chain a*2^j (Prop 1a): schedulable by construction

schedulers.harmonic: single-base harmonic rounding + residue assignment (guaranteed when rounded density <= 1)
schedulers.wheel: divisor-wheel: round each window down to a divisor of a common wheel length M, then assign residue classes with backtracking; a successful packing is itself the certificate. NOT the Chan-Chin 7/10 scheduler -- see Limitations.
